description: handle_mailbox_set (mailbox.rs:613-616) does a second full get_objects::<Mailbox> call to snapshot mailboxes_after_mutations before processing the destroy list. For accounts with many mailboxes this doubles the storage read. The data is only needed for the parent-child check (has_child). An alternative is to also check newly-created mailboxes' parentId values during the create loop and update the in-memory snapshot incrementally, avoiding the second backend round-trip. Expected impact: O(n) extra fetch on every Mailbox/set request that includes destroys, where n is total mailbox count.
title: Mailbox/set destroy: redundant full mailbox fetch per request
